jobs.title: (High Tech) Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Netherlands Mechanical 2 - 5 years Arnhem On-site

Want to make impact in an International High Tech environment?

About The Member Company

We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as:

* Technology & Engineering
* Energy & Renewables
* Life sciences & Pharma
* Digital & IT

**About this vacancy**
----------------------

In this role, you will work on something that does not yet exist: a completely new platform within our latest generation of Advanced Packaging machines. This is no development on an existing machine, but true pioneering. If you are passionate about turning complex mechanical concepts into reality and eager to make an impact, this position offers the perfect opportunity to apply your skills. You will work within a growing team where you can truly make impact. You will have the freedom to introduce and develop your own ideas, with ample opportunity for feedback and refinement from our team. You will work closely with our colleagues in Singapore and Hong Kong, as well as with external development partners in the Netherlands. Together we form the driving force behind machines that are deployed worldwide in high-tech industries. Key Responsibilities: - Design and develop mechanical concepts, modules, and components for high-precision systems, from initial concept through detailed design and release. All design work is done in NX and managed in Teamcenter. - Translate functional and system requirements into robust mechanical designs, ensuring performance, manufacturability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. - Perform tolerance analyses and detailed dimensioning, taking into account precision, thermal behaviour, and assembly constraints. - Conduct mechanical analyses and simulations (e.g. FEM, stiffness, deformation, eigenfrequencies, thermal effects) to validate design performance. - Collaborate closely with system engineers, mechatronics engineers, suppliers, and international teams (including Singapore and Hong Kong) to ensure alignment with system-level performance. - Contribute to the definition and realization of mechanical subsystem concepts, including prototype design and implementation. - Support integration and testing of prototypes and modules, perform root cause analysis, and implement design improvements. - Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, ensuring compliance with performance, quality, safety, and cleanroom (e.g. ISO 3) requirements. - Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DfM/DfA) and support industrialization. - Maintain structured technical documentation (drawings, specifications, change management) and contribute to continuous improvement and innovation, including support in patentable concepts where relevant.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Design; a PhD or PDEng in Mechanics is a plus. - 5+ years of industry experience in high-tech machine development, ideally in the semiconductor industry. - Proven expertise in developing and realizing mechanical concepts, ideally in the semiconductor industry. - A multidisciplinary thinker with an open-minded approach, strong in communication and collaboration across various technical domains. - A proactive mindset in overcoming challenges on conflicting demands of machine accuracy and machine throughput. Fluent in English; speaking Dutch is a plus.

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Mechanical Engineer**

**Wat ga je doen?**

Engineer ben je technisch verantwoordelijk voor het bedenken, uitwerken en vastleggen van 3D-ontwerpen, samenstellingen en opstellingstekeningen voor onze robotcellen. Je werkt aan R&D én aan klantprojecten, vertaalt klanteisen naar maakbare ontwerpen en zorgt voor een soepele overdracht naar productie en service. Voor onze klantprojecten configureer je de robotcellen grotendeels uit bestaande bouwblokken waarbij je regelmatig met klantspecifieke Engineer to Order features de puntjes op de i zet. In de R&D projecten werk je van definitie t/m realisatie samen met de andere engineeringsdisciplines aan nieuwe producten en features.

  

**Jouw belangrijkste taken:**
  
  
**Projectengineering:**

* Configureren van robotcellen uit beschikbare modules in 3D CAD (SolidWorks) en in ERP, afgestemd op klantspecificaties
* Maken van opstellingstekeningen van CNC‑machines met de robotcel
* Bedenken van klant specifieke features welke je af stemt met de klant, productie en service.

**R&D projecten:**

* Bedenken van concepten voor nieuwe producten en features op basis van specificaties, eisen en wensen. Dit doe je samen met de andere disciplines robot, electrical en software engineering
* Op basis van het beste concept ontwerpen van oplossingen in 3D CAD (SolidWorks) incl. bijbehorende technische berekeningen. Prototypen testen en bevindingen doorvoeren
* Uitwerken naar 2D‑tekeningen, afstemmen van maakbaarheid met werkplaats en leveranciers en borgen van data in ERP
* Ondersteunen van verkoop nog voor een robotcel verkocht is het bieden van klant specifieke oplossingen
* Continu verbeteren van producten via standaardisatie, modularisatie en kwaliteitsverhoging, o.b.v. eigen ideeën en feedback vanuit productie en service.
  

***Over BMO Automation***

*BMO Automation is sinds 2008 specialist in CNC*‑*automatisering en robotica. We ontwikkelen en bouwen slimme robotcellen voor de verspanende industrie, nationaal én internationaal. Innovatie, kwaliteit en teamwork staan centraal – én natuurlijk plezier en trots op wat we samen maken.*

*Je komt terecht in een enthousiast en gedreven team van drie Mechanical Engineers. Samen met je directe collega’s én de andere engineeringdisciplines werk je aan innovatieve robotoplossingen die wereldwijd worden ingezet.*

  

**Wat we jou bieden**

* **Salaris:** Uitstekend en afhankelijk van je ervaring
* **Contract:** jaarcontract met uitzicht op vast
* **Inwerktraject:** uitgebreid, met kennismaking met systemen, processen en collega’s
* **Vrije dagen:** 38 vakantiedagen (incl. ADV) bij fulltime dienstverband
* **Flexibele starttijden:** start tussen 07:00 en 09:00
* **Pensioen en overige regelingen:** volgen de CAO Metaal & Techniek, gezamenlijke pensioeninleg bij PMT, WIA‑hiaat, ANW‑hiaat en PAWW-verzekeringen (derde jaar WW)
* **Team & cultuur:** enthousiast team met mix van jong talent en ervaren collega’s
* **Ontwikkeling:** volop ruimte voor groei en verdieping
* **Extra’s:** gratis sporten in eigen fitnessruimte, vers fruit, EPIQ‑feesten en teamuitjes.
  

**Wat we van jou verwachten**

* MBO+/HBO werk‑ en denkniveau
* Afgeronde opleiding in Mechanical Engineering/ werktuigbouwkunde
* Ervaring met 3D CAD, bij voorkeur SolidWorks; kennis van MS Office en ERP (bijv. MKG)
* Technisch inzicht, analytisch vermogen en kwaliteitsbewustzijn; je werkt accuraat en gestructureerd
* Modulair denken; je vangt graag varianten in slimme standaardoplossingen
* Sterke beheersing van de Nederlandse taal
* Goede kennis van Engels en/of Duits is een pré.
  

**Ben jij een echte BMO’er?**

Bij BMO geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Een echte BMO’er is bevlogen, integer, vindt plezier in het werk en gelooft in de kracht van samenwerking.

* **Bevlogen:** Jij hebt een passie voor techniek en streeft ernaar altijd het beste uit jezelf en je team te halen. Je bent proactief en zoekt continu naar manieren om onze processen en dienstverlening te verbeteren.
* **Integer:** Eerlijkheid en betrouwbaarheid staan bij jou hoog in het vaandel. Je handelt altijd in het belang van de klant en het bedrijf, en houd je aan afspraken.
* **Plezier**: Je haalt voldoening uit je werk en draagt bij aan een positieve werksfeer. Bij BMO weten we dat plezier in het werk bijdraagt aan betere prestaties en een hechter team.
* **Samenwerken:** Je gelooft in de kracht van teamwork en ondersteunt je collega’s waar nodig. Je communiceert duidelijk en werkt samen aan gezamenlijke doelen.
  

**Onze cultuur**

Bij BMO heerst een open, informele cultuur waarin samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan. Jouw ideeën worden gewaardeerd en we stimuleren een proactieve houding. Samen werken we aan uitdagende projecten, behalen we successen en bieden we ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

*Empowering People to Push Potential into Performance.*

  

**Geïnteresseerd?**

Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden en ben je klaar om het verschil te maken? Stuur dan je CV en motivatie naar career@bmo-online.com.

  

Wij kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

  

**Past deze functie nét niet?**

Als je denkt dat de functie wél bij je past, maar dat je nog net niet alle vaardigheden beheerst, komen we ook graag met je in contact. Samen kijken we waar de mogelijkheden liggen om je verder te ontwikkelen tot deze functie.

  

**Vragen?**

Neem contact op met **Roel Verheijen/ Paul Janssen** via tel: **+31 (0) 495 622 437** voor meer informatie over de functie.

Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze HR-afdeling: via career@bmo-online.com of +31 (0) 495 622 437.

  

*ZZP’ers, uitzend- of wervingsbureaus hoeven niet op deze vacature te reageren.* *Dat scheelt jullie een bericht en ons een vriendelijk bedankje.*

jobs.title: Mechanical Project Engineer
Principal Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Netherlands Mechanical 10+ years Eindhoven Hybrid

Want to work on High Tech Packaging Machines which does not yet exist?

About The Member Company

We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as:

* Technology & Engineering
* Energy & Renewables
* Life sciences & Pharma
* Digital & IT

**About this vacancy**
----------------------

As a Principal Mechatronics Engineer you will work on something that does not yet exist: a completely new platform within our latest generation of Advanced Packaging machines. This is not an improvement of an existing machine, but true pioneering. If you are passionate about turning technical complex ideas into reality and eager to make an impact, this position offers the perfect opportunity to apply your skills.

Your work will focus on integrating advanced mechatronics, real-time control, and metrology solutions to meet the high demands of our customers in terms of accuracy and throughput. This position requires a high abstraction level, combining technical leadership, design expertise, and hands-on engineering to drive the creation of cutting-edge machines that will shape the future of electronics manufacturing.

You will work within a growing team where you can truly make impact. You will have the freedom to introduce and develop your own ideas, with ample opportunity for feedback and refinement from our team. You will work closely with our colleagues in Singapore and Hong Kong, as well as with external development partners in the Netherlands. Together we form the driving force behind machines that are deployed worldwide in high-tech industries.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Principal Mechatronics Engineer, you own the end-to-end mechatronic system architecture and ensure that performance is predictable, realizable, and scalable. Your efforts are instrumental in achieving high throughput while maintaining ultra precise die placement accuracy.

* Define and decompose system architecture into mechatronic sub-functions and derive quantitative motion, control and metrology requirements (e.g., bandwidth, settling time, stiffness, vibration, latency, sensor resolution).
* Define and validate performance budgets across mechanics, control, and metrology domains.
* Define and guide simulation approaches, control strategies, and metrology concepts to ensure performance budgets are achieved.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to develop functional modules and ensure alignment with ASMPT teams in Singapore and Hong Kong.
* Enable the testing and integration of machine prototypes and first production units. Ensure machines meet performance specifications during initial production.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers as the team expands.
* Work closely with teams in Beuningen, Singapore, and Hong Kong, and collaborate with external Dutch engineering partners for co-development and production.
* Occasional international travel to collaborate with product development centres in Asia and development partners in Europe.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

* Master’s degree in Mechatronics, or potentially a PhD or PDEng in the field.
* 10+ years of industry experience in high-tech machine development, ideally in the semiconductor industry.
* Proven expertise in mechatronics, real-time control, and metrology, specifically within the high-precision motion systems (nanometer domain).
* A multidisciplinary thinker with an open-minded approach, excelling in communication and collaboration across various technical domains.
* You are self-starting person and enjoy balancing system-level thinking with hands-on engineering.
* Strong ability to work effectively in teams while also being capable of independently driving technical solutions and initiatives.
* Fluent in English and Dutch.

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

TMC is an international high-tech consultancy company that brings expertise to its clients in order to support them with the realization of their technological challenges. As such, TMC is operating as an expert center at the disposition of its clients and we help them to be more competitive in an ever more global and faster-changing technological world. At TMC we believe that people are the driving force behind technological innovation. That is why we want to create the best possible conditions for tech talents to thrive in. We offer you a challenging and stimulating work environment in which you can be the director of your own career. As an Employeneur you are part of our TMC family. Next to our outstanding technical expertise, fun and engagement are meaningful parts of our culture.

jobs.title: Repair & Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,460 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.  
  
People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**

* Carry out daily repair and maintenance activities across the hotel, including guest rooms, restaurants, kitchens, public areas, offices, and back-of-house areas.
* Perform preventive maintenance on electrical, plumbing, mechanical, HVAC, and other hotel equipment and systems.
* Attend to maintenance requests and complaints from guests and colleagues promptly, ensuring minimal disruption to hotel operations.
* Respond to emergency maintenance calls, including guest room breakdowns, equipment failures, water leaks, and electrical issues.
* Conduct regular inspections of hotel facilities to identify potential defects and maintenance requirements.
* Ensure all guest room maintenance issues are resolved efficiently, coordinating with Housekeeping and Front Office to minimize room out-of-order time.
* Maintain and repair kitchen equipment, laundry equipment, pumps, motors, lighting, and other operational machinery.
* Support the Engineering team during hotel events, restaurant operations, and special functions to ensure all technical requirements are in place.
* Ensure all maintenance activities comply with hotel safety standards, fire and life safety regulations, and local authority requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance requests, completed jobs, equipment servicing, and preventive maintenance schedules.
* Monitor the condition of tools, equipment, and maintenance materials, reporting any requirements to the Chief Engineer.
* Coordinate with external contractors and service providers when specialized repairs or servicing are required.
* Ensure proper use, storage, and maintenance of engineering tools and equipment.
* Follow the hotel's energy conservation and sustainability initiatives by identifying opportunities to reduce water and electricity consumption.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of engineering workshops, plant rooms, and maintenance storage areas.
* Coordinate with other departments to ensure maintenance activities are carried out with minimum impact on guest satisfaction and daily hotel operations.
* Manage the attandance rosters for payroll processing
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Chief Engineer or Director of Engineering.
* Coordinate with external contractors and service providers for specialized repairs, inspections and servicing when required.
* Monitor contractor activities within the assigned work scope and report any quality or safety concerns to the Chief Engineer.

 **Qualifications**

* Diploma or technical certification in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Building Services Engineering.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a similar maintenance role, preferably within a hotel or hospitality environment.
* Good knowledge of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and general building maintenance.
* Experience in preventive maintenance and troubleshooting of hotel equipment and facilities.
* Basic knowledge of fire and life safety systems and hotel health and safety standards.
* Ability to read technical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance instructions.
* Good problem-solving skills and ability to respond effectively to urgent maintenance requirements.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and public holidays, depending on hotel operational requirements.

 **Additional Information**

**Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?**

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career -** No matter your background or experience, we invest in your **growth, learning, and career development**—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit -** Join a workplace that’s **inclusive, fun, and meaningful**. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our **Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**.

**Lead with Your Ambition -** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

* Prepare geotechnical designs and engineering evaluations for foundation systems across a range of construction and infrastructure projects.
* Assess soil conditions, groundwater levels, structural loading, seismic factors, and other site-related information to support safe and effective engineering designs.
* Develop suitable solutions for slope stabilization, landslide mitigation, retaining structures, embankments, ground improvement, and other earth support works.
* Examine geotechnical investigation reports, laboratory test results, and site data to prepare technical assessments, design calculations, and engineering recommendations.
* Produce design specifications, technical reports, calculations, and supporting documents for foundation construction, earthworks, ground treatment, and tender submissions.
* Work alongside structural engineers, architects, contractors, designers, and other project specialists to ensure geotechnical requirements are properly addressed throughout the design process.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Business**

J&C Joel Ltd has been trading successfully for over 40 years - with a HQ in the UK and a regional base in Dubai, employing over 100 people around the globe.

The company provides a wide range of products and services for the entertainment and events industry. These include; motorised rigging, stage engineering, flame retardant fabrics and technical drapery. Over the last 15 years J&C Joel has expanded and improved its Project department, which is responsible for the installation of drapery and mechanics into venues around the world.

**The Role**

The role will comprise of the following;

* Extensive experience working with AutoCAD (10+ years)
* Strong experience with SolidWorks (5+ years) or similar 3D packages
* Strong experience with Revit would be considered a plus.
* Produce detailed GA and Shop Drawings to facilitate the installation of standard and bespoke stage machinery, within performing art spaces.
* Understanding of construction drawing practices & standard, and experience within the construction industry is desirable.
* Work closely with engineers, architects, and other professionals to understand design requirements, clarify technical details and ensure the feasibility of designs.
* Overall coordination of design information from the J&C Joel team to the client, with appropriate follow-up to ensure approvals are obtained according to program.
* Ability to design parts and generate manufacture drawings for the following processes; sheet metal manufacture, fabricating, laser cutting, welding, machining, milling, turning.
* Undertake mechanical calculations to facilitate the design of electro-mechanical stage machinery
* Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, including bills of materials, assembly instructions, and engineering specifications.
* Experience of online portals (A-Site, BIM360, Aconnex, etc) to manage technical submissions and approvals is a plus.
* Contribute to the product development process by identifying opportunities for design improvements, cost reductions, or performance enhancements.
* Perform quality checks on design drawings and documents to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to standards.
* Consistently designing with safety in mind for both the end user and our installation team, within the context of industry BS standards and best practices.
* The primary focus of this role is mechanical, however a knowledge of electrical systems and control automation would be an advantage.
* Experience working with project managers and installation teams to deal with engineering matter arising on site.

**The Person**

This position requires a motivated, forward-thinking individual with an eye for detail and commercial business sense. The ability to work to deadlines and manage several projects simultaneously, thinking through the best design options to achieve the optimum safety and quality within a project’s constraints. The successful candidate will have the following;

* A diploma or bachelor's degree in engineering or related field.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.
* Keen attention to detail, with precision and accuracy in engineering drawings.
* Problem solving ability to resolve design issues and propose solutions.
* 10+ years of experience working within the construction industry.
* Ability to represent J&C Joel professionally in meetings with customers for design reviews.
* A strong team mentality, able to take ownership of your own tasks and workload.
* Capability to work with colleagues who are remote and in different time zones.

LYB hecht veel waarde aan diversiteit, gelijkheid en inclusie en zet zich in voor het bevorderen van het goede, met nadruk op onze planeet, de gemeenschappen waarin we actief zijn en onze toekomstige arbeidskrachten. Veiligheid staat bij jou voorop. Je vindt het daarom heel belangrijk om toe te zien op een juiste toepassing van de veiligheids-, bedrijfs- en milieuvoorschriften binnen je werkgebied en het naleven van deze voorschriften op de site.

Would you like to contribute to maintaining the infrastructure of tomorrow? From bridges and pumping stations to locks and flood defense systems. As a Maintenance Engineer, you ensure that our assets remain safe, reliable, and future-proof. You combine engineering expertise, data, and collaboration to develop smart maintenance solutions.
  

**THE POSITION**
----------------

As a Maintenance Engineer within Asset Management, you prepare maintenance activities for infrastructure assets in and around the water environment, analyse their technical condition, and continuously improve maintenance plans. You translate our clients’ maintenance requirements into practical and executable plans.
  
  
By assessing the technical condition of assets, you determine the maintenance activities required. You develop maintenance plans and cost analyses that support well-informed decision-making. Working closely with colleagues and other stakeholders, you help ensure that our infrastructure remains safe, reliable, and ready for the future.

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

You contribute to the maintenance of critical infrastructure assets, including bridges, pumping stations, and locks along the Lek, Maas, and Waal rivers, the Afsluitdijk, and assets located in the Dutch floodplains (*Uiterwaarden*). Using your technical expertise and analytical skills, you determine what maintenance activities are required and when they should be carried out.

  
  

You advise both internal and external stakeholders on the most effective maintenance approach. Your analyses enable teams to make well-founded decisions and organise maintenance activities efficiently. Together with your colleagues, you translate complex maintenance challenges into clear plans and tangible results. You will be responsible for:

* Analysing the technical condition of infrastructure assets and determining maintenance requirements;
* Developing and optimising maintenance plans based on client requirements and available data;
* Preparing cost analyses to support maintenance-related decision-making;
* Using maintenance management systems, such as Ultimo, to plan, manage, and monitor maintenance activities;
* Advising internal and external stakeholders on maintenance solutions and opportunities for process improvement.
  

  

### **YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT**

You will become part of a close-knit Maintenance team consisting of four colleagues. Together with the Tender Management, Project Management, and Process Management teams, you will be part of the Asset Management department. Through collaboration across different disciplines, you will share knowledge, learn from others, and contribute to a wide variety of infrastructure projects.

You will regularly work from our office in **Gorinchem**.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

You enjoy tackling technical challenges and approach your work in an analytical and structured way. You are able to translate complex information into clear recommendations and know how to engage different stakeholders in your proposals. You enjoy collaborating with colleagues, learning from others, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve maintenance practices and processes.

In addition, you bring:

* A completed MBO level 4 qualification combined with several years of relevant work experience, or a completed HBO (Bachelor's) degree;

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about life sciences and engineering? Are you excited by the challenge of turning innovative biotech designs into reliable, scalable products? Do you thrive in a hands-on, problem-solving environment where you can drive continuous improvement, tackle complex technical challenges, and help shape the future of medical research and drug development?

If so, Optics11 Life is the place for you!

**Who we are**

Optics11 Life is a life sciences scale-up headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. We develop and manufacture the instruments researchers use to measure what cells sense, so they can make better-informed decisions in drug development. Over 300 instruments are in use worldwide, and our technology underpins more than 800 scientific publications.

**Purpose of this role**

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are the technical link between R&D and production, solving challenges at their root to ensure our products can be manufactured reliably, efficiently, and at scale. You drive continuous improvement across assembly, testing, and supply chain processes, strengthening product quality, manufacturability, and long-term reliability while reducing operational and technology risks. As both a technical problem-solver and a driver of production excellence, you help turn innovative designs into robust, scalable products.

**Key activities**

* Identify and implement design improvements to enhance product manufacturability, reliability and serviceability.
* Lead structured root cause analyses and drive the implementation of lasting corrective and preventive actions.
* Resolve complex supply chain challenges by mitigating single-source and end-of-life component risks and qualifying alternative suppliers.
* Collaborate with R&D to integrate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfM/DfA) principles into new and existing products.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex assembly and testing issues, acting as the first point of technical escalation across subassemblies, complete instruments and consumables.
* Create, update and maintain maintenance manuals and work instructions to support reliable product servicing.
* Define inspection and test requirements and develop production test plans and setups for incoming and intermediate inspections.
* Create and update maintenance manuals and step-by-step work instructions covering intermediate production stages, product inspection, maintenance, servicing and troubleshooting.

* MSc in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing, production, or process engineering in a high-mix, low-volume environment.
* Extensive experience with common test equipment such as oscilloscopes, load cells, flatness tables, micrometers, and optical equipment.
* Knowledge of mechanical design and 3D CAD modelling, with a working understanding of electrical schematics.
* Hands-on attitude: comfortable on the production floor and at the test bench.
* Experience with structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, supplier management, component qualification, and engineering change control.
* Familiarity with design reviews and stage-gate processes.
* Analytical, structured, and data-driven, with a practical, hands-on approach.
* Clear communicator, able to collaborate across R&D, production, purchasing, and management.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer

jobs.description:
**Introductie**
---------------

Bij TenneT werken we aan een energievoorziening die Nederland in beweging houdt. Als Maintenance Engineer maak jij direct impact op de toekomst van ons elektriciteitsnet. Jij speelt een sleutelrol in het beheer en onderhoud van onze kritieke locaties. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan duurzaam onderhoud van onze data- en controlcentra zodat we Nederland kunnen blijven voorzien van betrouwbare energie. Dankzij jouw inzet zorgen we voor een stabiel elektriciteitsnet van vandaag en morgen.

**Jouw rol**
------------

Als Maintenance Engineer ben jij mede verantwoordelijk voor het versterken en vernieuwen van het elektriciteitsnet, zodat Nederland kan blijven rekenen op betrouwbare en duurzame energie.

Je komt te werken in het team Maintenance binnen Real Estate and Facility Management, bestaande uit 17 gedreven collega’s. Samen werken jullie aan het beheer en onderhoud, asset management en modificaties van onze gebouwen, een essentiële taak voor een stabiele en duurzame energievoorziening. Binnen ons team heerst een open en professionele werksfeer, waarin samenwerking, kwaliteit en veiligheid centraal staan.

  
  

Jij draagt de regie en eindverantwoordelijkheid voor onze onderhoudsplanning en de succesvolle oplevering van het onderhoud. Je borgt een heldere verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden binnen het team en zorgt door dagelijkse aansturing van de technisch specialisten voor een effectieve en voorspelbare operationele uitvoering.

  
  

Je vertaalt assetstrategie en beleidskaders naar concrete onderhoudsopdrachten en stuurt onderhoudspartijen aan op resultaat. Je zorgt voor een heldere onderhoudsvraag en borgt een eenduidige werkwijze op de werkvloer..

Verder ben je onder andere ook verantwoordelijk voor:

* Inrichten, beheren en optimaliseren van onderhoudsplannen, taaklijsten en onderhoudsfrequenties;
* Regie voeren op de planning en beschikbaarheid van kritiek onderhoud;
* Aansturen van onderhoudspartijen en actief sturen op kwaliteit, kosten en prestaties;
* De afstemming met de technisch asset manager over MJOP, jaarplannen en onderhoudsstrategieën;
* Het zorgen voor een correcte en consistente registratie van de onderhoudsdata;
* Verbeteren van onderhoudsprocessen en deze doorvoeren richting leveranciers;
* Bewaken van samenwerking en bijsturen op resultaat op basis van input uit de operatie.

**Waar kom je terecht**
-----------------------

Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM) ontwikkelt, realiseert en beheert de fysieke werkomgeving van TenneT. Van kantoren en warehouses tot datacenters en control centers: RE&FM zorgt voor veilige, betrouwbare, duurzame en toekomstbestendige locaties. Met geïntegreerde vastgoed-, facility- en securitydiensten, professioneel assetmanagement en een sterke focus op gebruikerservaring ondersteunt RE&FM de primaire processen van TenneT en draagt zij bij aan de versnelling van de energietransitie. RE&FM maakt onderdeel uit van de divisie Digital & Technology Transformation (DTT), de digitale ruggengraat van TenneT.

**Jouw profiel & achtergrond**
------------------------------

Bij TenneT zoeken we professionals die bijdragen aan de toekomst van ons elektriciteitsnet. We verwachten dat je de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden hebt om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan ons team en onze missie.

  
  

Wat breng jij mee?

* Besluitvaardig – je durft keuzes te maken, je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en je stelt scherp prioriteiten
* Communicatief sterk – je weet verschillende belangen te overbruggen
* Technisch inhoudelijk stevig – je kan inhoudelijk sparren en beoordelen, en vertaalt inhoud naar implementatie
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in op het snijvlak van techniek, regie en opdrachtgeverschap, bij voorkeur in de industriesector of vergelijkbare hoog technische omgevingen.
* Diepgaande kennis van onderhoud- en onderhoudsprocessen en ervaring met het aansturen van externe partijen
* Een afgeronde HBO opleiding of HBO werk- en denkniveau bij voorkeur in de techniek
* Bereidheid om deel te nemen aan een tweedelijns 24/7 wacht- en storingsdienst voor storingen en incidenten.

**Arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------

TenneT biedt jou de kans om bij te dragen aan een duurzame energietoekomst. Samen met collega’s, partners en stakeholders werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen die de energietransitie mogelijk maken. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je talent te ontwikkelen en werk je in een omgeving waarin jouw groei centraal staat. Wij stimuleren initiatief en geven je de ruimte om met nieuwe ideeën te komen.

  
  

Wij bieden jou:

* Een vast contract met twee maanden proeftijd, op basis van 40 uur per week.
* Een salaris in schaal 8: €4276,- tot €8443,-, met daar bovenop per maand 8% vakantiegeld en 6% eindejaarsuitkering.
* Een solide pensioen via ABP: wij betalen 70% van jouw premie.
* 43 verlofdagen per jaar.
* Alle genoemde arbeidsvoorwaarden gelden bij een fulltime dienstverband, tenzij anders vermeld.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met **Rutger Prins via Rutger.Prins@TenneT.eu**

**Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal daarom niet in behandeling worden genomen.**

**Sollicitatieproces**
----------------------

jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a **Junior** **Quantum Design Engineer**, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.
* Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.
* Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.
* Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.
* Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.

**Your Profile**

* MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).
* Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.
* Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).
* Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.
* Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.
* Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.
* Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.
  
  
**What We Offer:**

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

**Competitive salary** - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

**Personal growth** - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

**A connected team** - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

jobs.title: IC Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
In this role you will be part of the Nexperia Business Group (BG) IC Solutions Logic development team, you will take ownership of the implementation of the technical requirements of products in logic families and switch families. You are expected to understand CMOS, IC design and analog IC design tools (Cadence or Synopsys).

**What you will do**

Your mission is to develop and release products, which are combinations of integrated circuits and plastic packages, produced and tested at high volumes at the lowest possible cost. These products meet all datasheet specifications, customer requirements, industry standards and quality requirements.

During the study, concept, design, validation and qualification phase of each project, you will contribute to a cross-functional team of design engineering, product engineering, test engineering and product quality engineer. You will drive chip design, specifications setting and verification while having the ownership of the top-level layout fit for all required packages.

As **design engineer**, you will make your key contributions to the design of cost-effective products by applying the most efficient way for the implementation of a set of designs within a logic family. You will develop master designs that can be configured into multiple derivative functions, sharing pin functionality and packages. You will implement customer requirements and make sure the product will meet datasheet values. You will do full top-level verification and specification setting agreement with the product manager.

**Besides this you will work on:**

* Design integrated circuits in 0.5um to 0.18um feature size CMOS and BCD wafer processes.
* Develop the products in a wide range of plastic packages.
* Design circuits with existing circuit techniques and optimize for area.
* Design, optimization and simulations on block level and top level of the IC using Synopsys/Cadence tools.
* Achieve First Time Right designs.
* Top-level functional simulations, full statistical verification of building blocks and datasheet parameters.
* Floor-planning, layout of blocks and top-level layout and wiring diagram creation.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering
* Entry level experienced in circuit design and analog EDA tools and simulations techniques.
* Understanding of semiconductor device physics and device characteristics.
* Understanding of standard CMOS technology.
* Basic knowledge of ESD mechanisms and protection.
* Possesses Analytical Skills and ability to apply pragmatic approaches.
* Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Team player and target driven, shows initiative, has an entrepreneurial attitude and works independently.

**Why work for us?**
--------------------

* Flexible working hours and possibility of overtime reduction to maintain a Work-Life-Balance.
* Permanent employment contract with a competitive salary and supplementary voluntary employee benefits.
* Attractive Bonus.
* A wide variety of training courses and career development options.
* Numerous further benefits, such as retirement provisions, travel allowance, company events, sports and leisure activities, employee discounts and even more.

**About the team**
------------------

You will come to work in a larger team of IC Design Engineers and ESD experts as your direct colleagues, all closely working together in the Nijmegen location of Nexperia. The team is divided into three products groups, which are Standard Logic and Switches, Voltage Translators and I2C controlled GPIO and Switches and eFuse power switches.

The focus of your job will be Logic and Switch families. For your role you will have highly advanced design tools at your disposal to perform design and simulations yourself.

The design and layout of circuits are done with tools of world leading EDA vendors. The design groups work closely together with the Front End and Back End technology teams in Nijmegen for the development of integrated circuits and packages.

**Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark.**

**D&I Statement**

As an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.

In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
De Maintenance Engineer bij Equans werkt binnen de afdeling Asset Management en ondersteunt klanten in industrie en utiliteit met het optimaliseren van technische installaties. In deze rol analyseer je onderhoudsdata, prestaties en risico’s, en vertaal je inzichten naar onderhoudsstrategieën, onderhoudsplannen en verbetervoorstellen. Je voert storings-, risico- en root cause analyses uit, ondersteunt de inrichting van onderhoudsmanagementsystemen en adviseert klanten over onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken. Daarnaast werk je mee aan onderhoudscontracten, tenders, ontwerptrajecten en innovatieve oplossingen zoals asset performance management, risicogestuurd onderhoud, digitalisering, voorspellend onderhoud en data-analyse. De functie vraagt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol en ervaring met FMECA, RCA, onderhoudsprotocollen en Maintenance Management Informatiesystemen. Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, technische bedrijfskunde of een aanverwante technische studie is gewenst. De rol biedt een vast contract, een salaris tot maximaal € 6100 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, een winstdelingsregeling tot 10% en 38 vrije dagen per jaar.

**Description**
---------------

Wil jij impact maken met techniek én advies? Als Maintenance Engineer analyseer je prestaties, minimaliseer je risico’s en ontwikkel je slimme onderhoudsstrategieën die direct bijdragen aan de continuïteit en prestaties van technische installaties.

  

**Maintenance Engineer**

  

**Dit ga je doen**

Als Maintenance Engineer binnen Equans maak je deel uit van de afdeling Asset Management en help je klanten in de industrie en utiliteit om hun technische installaties optimaal te laten presteren. Je analyseert onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken en vertaalt data en inzichten naar slimme oplossingen die prestaties verbeteren, risico's verlagen en kosten beheersbaar houden. Je duikt in onderhoudsdata, storingen, prestaties en risico's om de betrouwbaarheid, beschikbaarheid en veiligheid van installaties te vergroten. Op basis van jouw analyses ontwikkel je onderhoudsstrategieën, voer je risico- en storingsanalyses uit en achterhaal je de oorzaken van terugkerende problemen. Deze inzichten zet je om in concrete verbetervoorstellen waarmee klanten hun onderhoudsorganisatie verder professionaliseren. Daarnaast stel je onderhoudsplannen op, optimaliseer je bestaande onderhoudsconcepten en ondersteun je bij de inrichting en doorontwikkeling van onderhoudsmanagementsystemen. Je helpt klanten om meer grip te krijgen op hun assets en ondersteunt hen bij het maken van onderbouwde keuzes voor de korte én lange termijn. Je bent een inhoudelijk sterke adviseur die makkelijk schakelt tussen techniek, operatie en management. Je werkt nauw samen met commercie- en contractmanagers en bezoekt regelmatig klanten en prospects. Tijdens deze gesprekken inventariseer je onderhoudsuitdagingen, presenteer je assetmanagement-oplossingen en laat je zien hoe een slimme onderhoudsaanpak bijdraagt aan hogere prestaties, lagere risico's en een langere levensduur van installaties. Daarmee speel je niet alleen een belangrijke rol in lopende projecten, maar draag je ook actief bij aan de verdere groei van onze assetmanagementdiensten.

  

Binnen Equans werk je aan een grote diversiteit aan projecten voor verschillende klanten, installaties en sectoren. Je ondersteunt opdrachtgevers bij het professionaliseren van hun onderhoudsorganisatie en levert een bijdrage aan onderhoudscontracten, ontwerptrajecten en tenders. Daarnaast denk je mee over innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van Asset Performance Management, risicogestuurd onderhoud, digitalisering, voorspellend onderhoud en data-analyse. Deze functie biedt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en afwisseling. Je krijgt de kans om kennis en expertise in te zetten bij uiteenlopende organisaties en levert direct een bijdrage aan veiligere, betrouwbaardere en toekomstbestendige assets.

  

**Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden op een rij:**

* Analyseren van onderhoudsdata, prestaties en risico’s om de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van installaties te vergroten
* Ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en beheren van onderhoudsstrategieën, onderhoudsplannen en onderhoudsmanagementsystemen
* Uitvoeren van storings-, risico- en root cause analyses en deze vertalen naar concrete verbeteracties
* Adviseren van klanten over onderhouds- en assetmanagementvraagstukken en het verbeteren van onderhoudsprocessen
* Meewerken aan innovatieve projecten, onderhoudscontracten, tenders en de ontwikkeling van toekomstgerichte onderhoudsdiensten

**Dit bieden wij jou**

Natuurlijk begrijpen we dat voorwaarden belangrijk voor je zijn. Daarom bieden we je een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, waaronder:

* Salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring tot maximaal € 6100 bruto per maand, o.b.v. 40 uur
* Vakantiegeld 8 %

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you’re looking for a role where you can fully express your creativity and problem-solving skills. Ideally, you'd like to do this for an innovative company, one you can be proud of. At Teqram, we’re working on one of the biggest innovations in industrial automation: autonomous vision guided robots.

**Your Key Challenge as a Mechanical Engineer:**

Together with our other mechanical engineers, you will be responsible for quickly developing high-quality, mechatronic systems. We build standardized solutions which are highly configurable to customer specific use-cases. Most of our robots are used in the sheet metal and plate industry, so every solution you create must not only be functional but also robust.

Your work starts with a problem that probably has not been solved before. On top of that there are challenging constraints and demands such as space, form-factor, cost, maintainability and durability.

You will be part of a dynamic, social, and highly intelligent team of professionals who are passionate about what they do. We expect you to have a strong interest in other disciplines such as electrical engineer and software in order to be succesful.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Developing concept solutions.
* Drafting concepts in Solidworks.
* Improving existing systems.
* Liasing with production for any design questions
* Supervising prototype construction.

**We take on the challenges others didn't dare to, will you?**

We are looking for a pragmatic, inventive, and technically skilled colleague. You design in a way that ensures the robot performs its tasks effectively and consistently. Every design you create has been carefully thought through. You either have experience or a strong affinity with industrial automation, robotics, and/or machinery. You’re an approachable team member, someone who quickly gets to the heart of the matter and isn’t satisfied until you fully understand the problem. During busy periods, you know how to set your priorities. You also enjoy being part of a close-knit team and work well with your colleagues.

**What we expect from you as a Mechanical Engineer:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Automation.
* Proficiency in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written.
* Experience with Solidworks or other 3D software.
* Hands-on technical skills

**Job Requirements:**

We ask a lot, but we offer much more.

Most importantly, you will be contributing to one of the most significant innovations in robotics in recent years. You will also work in an environment where you can apply your experience and ideas. We expect commitment, but we also offer it in return. Together, we strive for continuous improvement, and from day one, your opinions will be valued. Teqram is financially stable, allowing us to invest strategically to maintain and expand our unique position. We ensure that you will find challenges here and, importantly, continue to find them.

**Are you ready to push the boundaries of robotic automation?**

Join Teqram and be part of a team that’s shaping the future!

For more information, feel free to contact Martin Bruins via 06-29113915 or m.bruins@tosec.nl

jobs.title: Senior Engineer I, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description:
Netherlands > Almere

  

**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

**Job's mission**

We are seeking innovative, motivated recent graduates to join our team as Mechanical Engineers. In this role, you will contribute to new product development, sustainment, and engineering design projects. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging problems, is thorough and detail-oriented, and uses experimentation and model-based analysis to identify root causes. You will collaborate effectively with cross-disciplinary teams to solve complex engineering problems and drive new technological advancements.

**What you will be working on**

Responsibilities:

* Design mechanical systems and products supporting ASM process chambers using sound engineering principles
* Interpret and design to gas, water and pneumatic schematics
* Create and manage 3D CAD models (Creo) and 2D drawings with GD&T
* Perform engineering analysis including structural, thermal, and fluid dynamics
* Lead hardware development from concept through testing and HVM readiness
* Participate in design reviews and drive DFx activities
* Collaborate with suppliers to resolve fabrication challenges
* Prepare clear, complete engineering documentation to support prototype builds, manufacturing, and testing.
* Support cost estimation for new features and enhancements

Requirements:

* Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or higher
* 0-3 years of experience in mechanical design using 3D CAD (Creo preferred)
* Knowledge of vacuum and thermal systems, gas/fluid delivery, wafer handling
* Understanding of materials: QTZ; SiC; metals, surface coatings and surface finishes.
* Knowledge of GD&T and engineering drawing standards
* Cleanroom experience of deposition technologies (CVD, ALD, EPI, PVD), hand-on assembly and testing experiences are strongly preferred

  

**Apply today to be part of what’s next.**

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

You will work in multidisciplinary teams alongside system architects, mechanical engineers, mechatronics engineers, manufacturing specialists and suppliers. **HVAC Installation & Retrofit Engineer**  
Dubai (projects across the UAE)

Join RGS HVAC Services. We're hiring an experienced HVAC site engineer to lead our installation and retrofit projects across occupied commercial and residential buildings in the UAE.

We offer accommodation or an accommodation allowance, company vehicle, fuel & parking, health insurance, annual home-country flight tickets and performance bonuses.

**ABOUT US**

RGS provides HVAC maintenance and retrofit solutions across the UAE. We focus on quality workmanship, safety and customer satisfaction, and invest in our people through training, modern tools and long-term career development.

**THE ROLE**

You will run our installation and retrofit projects from survey to handover – owning the technical scope, leading technicians and subcontractors on site, keeping work safe and on programme, and making sure every system is installed, tested and commissioned properly.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage the installation, replacement and upgrade of AHUs, FAHUs, FCUs, VRF systems, fans, motors and coils.
* Carry out site surveys, measurements, heat-load checks and material take-offs; prepare equipment selections and technical submittals.
* Review drawings and coordinate with consultants, clients and our projects/sales team on scope, variations and technical queries.
* Plan and lead site teams and subcontractors; allocate daily work against the project programme.
* Read and work from mechanical drawings, electrical wiring diagrams and control schematics.
* Prepare method statements and risk assessments, and manage permits to work in occupied buildings.
* Plan shutdowns and changeovers to minimise disruption to tenants and clients.
* Oversee rigging and lifting of rooftop and plant-room equipment.
* Coordinate controls and BMS integration, EC fans, VFDs and 0–10V control signals with the controls/BMS team.
* Lead testing and commissioning, support air balancing (TAB) and verify correct operating sequences.
* Enforce HSE standards on site and run toolbox talks.
* Submit daily progress reports with photos; complete snag lists, testing and handover records.
* Act as the main technical point of contact for clients, consultants and building management.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a Diploma with strong UAE project experience).
* Minimum 5 years of HVAC installation and/or retrofit experience, including at least 2 years as a site or project engineer leading teams in the UAE.
* Hands-on experience with HVAC controls/BMS and with testing & commissioning of AHUs, FAHUs and VRF systems.
* Strong knowledge of AHU/FAHU, VRF, chilled-water and DX systems, with a sound grasp of psychrometrics, airflow and heat-load fundamentals.
* Able to read mechanical/electrical drawings and control schematics, and prepare technical submittals.
* Experience working in live or occupied buildings and with permit-to-work systems.
* Valid UAE driving licence – mandatory.
* Good spoken and written English; comfortable with Excel, AutoCAD and WhatsApp reporting.
* IOSH, NEBOSH or similar HSE certificate is an advantage.

**BENEFITS**

* Company accommodation or accommodation allowance.
* Company vehicle, fuel and parking.
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Annual round-trip flight ticket to your home country.
* Yearly performance bonuses of up to four times monthly salary.
* Continuous training and career development.

**WORKING HOURS**

Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, including a one-hour break. Occasional night or weekend shutdown work is required on retrofit projects.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV and a short list of HVAC installation or retrofit projects you have handled, including your role on each.

Je verdiept je in de technische vraagstukken van de klant en werkt deze uit tot doordachte ontwerpen van mechanische systemen en constructies. Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

#### **The Role**

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.
* Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.
* Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.
* Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.
* Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.
* Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.
* Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness.
* Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements.
* Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities.
* Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications.
* Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution.
* Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges.
* Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture.

#### **What we offer**

* Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.
* Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.
* A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* 30 days of holiday per year.
* Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.

**Requirements**

* BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments.
* Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards.
* Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.
* Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems.
* Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.
* Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.
* Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

**Preferred**

* Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.
* Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.
* Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.
* Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

#### **Screening**

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

\* Understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and production requirements.

\* Knowledge of quality standards such as ISO and ASME.

\* Experience with simulation and stress analysis software is an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies:**

\* Strong technical and analytical skills.

**Manufacturing Engineer**
--------------------------

### **Wat ga je doen als manufacturing engineer?**

Als manufacturing engineer bij VHE in Eindhoven zorg je ervoor dat complexe elektrotechnische systemen goed, snel en met constante kwaliteit gemaakt worden. Bij nieuwe producten bepaal je samen met Sales hoe we ze het best kunnen bouwen. Je kijkt al vroeg mee naar het ontwerp en past de principes van Design for Manufacturing en Design for Assembly toe, zodat het product makkelijker en betrouwbaarder te maken is.

Loopt er iets mis in de productie, dan zoek je de oorzaak met een root cause analysis en los je het praktisch op. Je schrijft en onderhoudt de werkinstructies, procedures en specificaties waarmee onze assemblagemonteurs werken. Samen met Werkvoorbereiding en de andere afdelingen verbeter je continu het proces en de kwaliteit van onze producten.

### **Wat neem je mee?**

* Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, mechatronica of industriële automatisering.
* Kennis van procesverbetering, zoals Lean of een Green Belt, en ervaring met FMEA en control plans.
* Je kunt elektrische en mechanische tekeningen en schema’s lezen en interpreteren.
* Je bent analytisch sterk, werkt oplossingsgericht en neemt zelf initiatief.
* Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.

### **Een pré**

* Ervaring in een hightech productieomgeving.
* Kennis van NPI en van assemblage van complexe elektrotechnische systemen.
* Ervaring met assemblage in een cleanroom.

### **Wat bieden wij?**

* € 3.800 tot € 4.600 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring. Plus vakantiegeld en uitbetaalde overuren.
* 40 verlofdagen per jaar.
* Flexibele start tussen 7:00 en 8:30 uur.
* Een arbeidsovereenkomst bij VHE voor minimaal 7 maanden.
* Reiskostenvergoeding en fietsleaseregeling.

Je krijgt de ruimte om impact te maken op hoe wij produceren. Wij investeren in de trainingen die je nodig hebt om verder te groeien.

Mail je cv naar personeelszaken@vhe.nl. Binnen 2 werkdagen nemen we contact met je op. Klikt het, dan nodigen we je uit voor een gesprek met rondleiding over de werkvloer. Binnen 1 week na dat gesprek weet je waar je aan toe bent.
